title: ArkBlock says it is responding to a cyberattack and has found no loss of user assets so far
date_note: Bloomingbit, published 25 November (KST), says ArkBlock's statement came on the 26th local time; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: the source does not state where ArkBlock is based
summary: Bloomingbit, citing BlockBeats, reports that ArkBlock says it is responding to a cyberattack. ArkBlock says no loss or theft of user assets has been found so far. It says it is rebuilding server nodes, replacing authentication credentials and reviewing infrastructure access rights against a potential advanced persistent threat, and that some services may be temporarily affected.
plain: ArkBlock says it is dealing with a cyberattack and has found no sign that user assets were lost or stolen. It says some services may be briefly affected while it rebuilds servers.
exec: ArkBlock says it is responding to a cyberattack and some services may be temporarily affected; it says no user asset loss has been found so far.

validation.note: Only Bloomingbit (citing BlockBeats) was read; it quotes ArkBlock's statement. ArkBlock's own page was not found.
